```yaml
architecture:
  style: nestjs
  layers:
    - name: domain
      kind: domain
      directories:
        - src/app/**/models/**
        - src/app/interfaces/**
      roles: [entity, value-object]
    - name: infrastructure
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/app/database/**
        - src/app/redis/**
        - src/app/config/**
        - src/app/cookie/**
        - src/app/options/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.repository.ts"
        - "**/google/**"
        - "**/local/**"
      roles: [repository-impl, external-service]
    - name: application
      kind: application
      file_patterns:
        - "src/app/**/*.service.ts"
      roles: [application-service]
    - name: presentation
      kind: presentation
      file_patterns:
        - "src/app/**/*.controller.ts"
        - "src/app/**/*.module.ts"
        - "src/app/**/*.guard.ts"
      roles: [controller, module, guard]
      decorators: ["@Controller", "@Module"]
```
